info.name: DriveDeck Admin API
info.description:
Operator console (Admin / Superadmin) API, generated from docs/api_doc_admin.md.

AUTH: session-based (Django sessions). POST {{base_url}}/api/accounts/v1/login/ sets a `sessionid` cookie; Postman's cookie jar persists it automatically for {{base_url}}, so subsequent requests are authenticated with no extra header. Login/logout are CSRF-exempt — no X-CSRFToken needed.

ROLES: admin (scoped to own shop) or superadmin (global). user/driver get 403 on admin endpoints. Settlement, payout & refund endpoints are superadmin-only.

VARIABLES: set `base_url` (collection variable, default http://localhost:8000) and the various *_id variables as you go.

request.description: AllowAny entry point. Sets the sessionid cookie (auth for everything else). Throttled 5/hour (429). Returns the full UserSerializer — check `role` is admin/superadmin.
IsAuthenticated. Empty body. Clears the session -> {"message": "Logged out"}.
UserSerializer. Dashboard header uses first_name, profile_picture, role.
{"unread": 3}. Hide badge when 0.
IsAdmin. All KPI cards in one call. admin -> own shops; superadmin -> all. driver_inspector block is global.
IsAdmin. Unpaginated array of 5 newest events (carwash + DI for superadmin). Each row carries either booking or di_booking.
IsAdmin. Full paginated feed (PAGE_SIZE 20). Shop-only for admins; superadmin all. Does NOT include platform DI events.
IsAuthenticated (caller's own). Paginated envelope; count powers the 'N notifications' label.
404 if the id isn't the caller's. -> {"success": true}.
-> {"success": true, "updated": N}.

request.description: ShopRolePermission (admin/superadmin). Always created status=inactive. supported_vehicle_types must be canonical (hatchback,sedan,suv,convertible,bike); [] = all. Admin can create only one shop.
ShopRolePermission. superadmin -> all; admin -> own shop. Paginated cards.
ShopDetailSerializer. settlement block present only for owning admin / superadmin.

Toggle the 'Shop active' state via `status` (NOT is_active, which is read-only/ignored). Activate requires >=1 active ShopService else 400. Also accepts latitude/longitude and other ShopSerializer fields.
Cards with summary / from_price / variants. estimated_minutes = duration_in_slots * 30.
Nested alias for the shop's services (ShopViewSet.shop_services). Same shape as GET /shop-services/?shop={id}.
uniform_pricing=true -> send top-level price + duration_in_slots, omit variants. false -> >=1 variant. duration is in 30-min slots.
PATCH any field. Sending variants on PATCH REPLACES the set (absent types deleted, present upsert by vehicle_type).
Copies active services + variants. Name collisions skipped. target_shop required for superadmin, ignored for admin. -> {"copied": N, "skipped": M}.
percent e.g. 10 or -5, must be > -100. shop required for superadmin. -> {"services_updated": N, "variants_updated": M}.
IsSuperAdmin. net_payable, pending_total, last_settled, lifetime_paid, items[].
Settles ALL currently-pending bookings into one paid batch. 400 if nothing pending; 409 on concurrent settle. other_adjustments / net_override optional.
{count, results:[payout]} newest first.
Every shop with current net payable. Sorted highest pending first.
Parallel to the shop settlements overview, for workers.
Paginated full payouts. Detail screen reuses the same row (no separate detail endpoint).
Static shared Slot reference grid (id, start_time). Fetch once; per-day slot list is derived client-side between opening_slot and closing_slot.
ShopRolePermission. One row per (shop, weekday). admin auto-scoped; superadmin pass ?shop=. A weekday with NO row = OFF day.
Create one (shop, weekday) open/close row. shop required for superadmin, auto for admin. 400 if (shop, weekday) already exists — PATCH instead.
Change a day's hours. To make an open day an OFF day, DELETE the row instead.

item.name: Weekly schedule — delete row (make OFF day)

request.description: Removes the (shop, weekday) row -> that weekday becomes an OFF day.

item.name: Copy one day to all weekdays

request.description: Copies this row's opening_slot/closing_slot to all other 6 weekdays (create-or-update). Empty body. Returns the full 7-day list. Overwrites OFF days too.
Recurring weekly per-slot OFF toggles. One row per (shop, weekday, slot). Filter by ?shop= and ?weekday=. DELETE a row to turn the slot back on.

item.name: Slot breaks — create (turn one slot off)

request.description: Turns one hourly slot OFF on a weekday, recurring. shop required for superadmin, auto for admin.
Replaces ALL breaks for one (shop, weekday) with slot_ids. slot_ids:[] clears the day. Backs the 'tap slots then Save' flow. Returns the resulting break list.

item.name: Slot breaks — delete (turn slot back on)

request.description: Removes the break -> the slot is bookable again.
No dedicated endpoint — toggle Shop.use_slot_level_capacity on the shop. OFF=daily_booking_cap governs; ON=per-slot ShopCapacity governs.
IsAdmin. Global labeled holiday closing one or more shops. ?upcoming=true -> date>=today; ?shop=<id> -> holidays including that shop. Admin list scoped to own shops.
IsAdmin. Closes each linked shop on the date. admin may only attach own shop(s) (omit shops -> defaults to admin's shops; foreign shop -> 400). superadmin any shops.
IsAdmin. Removes the holiday (the x on the card).

item.name: Per-shop date override (close one shop / custom hours)

request.description: ShopWeeklyBusinessOverride — close a SINGLE shop on a date or give it one-off hours. Drives shop detail's next_holiday. Use a Holiday for a shared closure across shops.
IsAuthenticated. admin/superadmin -> all; driver/inspector -> assigned; user -> own.
Full DriverAndInspectionBookingSerializer (worker card, timeline). OTPs null for admin/worker.

query.description: optional; defaults to the request's start_slot

request.description: IsAdmin. Candidate workers with server-authoritative `available` flag.
IsAdmin. Use driver_id for driver requests. Sets status=assigned, generates fresh start/end OTPs. Re-call reassigns. 409 if busy.
IsAdmin. Generic transition + timeline entry. How Contacted and quoted_fee are set.
IsAssignedWorkerOrAdmin. Requires status=assigned and advance paid. Sets status=arrived. Required before Start Job.
Requires status=arrived. -> in_progress. lat/lng/location_text optional. 400 wrong OTP, 409 if not arrived.
Requires status=in_progress. -> completed. Computes final bill (driver overage / inspector fixed), releases worker, credits earnings.
Itemised breakdown once completed.
IsAdmin-class. CustomerListSerializer cards. Pick id -> customer_id.
IsAdmin. Include otp_code to verify, or omit for override path. 409 if phone exists (body has customer_id). Creates role=user.
IsAdmin. Created at status=new. trip_type required for driver. inspection_type (pre_purchase/pre_sale) for inspection. car_id optional (must belong to customer).
admin -> own shops; superadmin -> all. Not date-scoped by default.
Full BookingSerializer (customer, vehicle, journey, services, timeline, embedded damage card).
IsAdmin (shop-scoped). Active drivers with `available` flag for the booking's slot span.
IsAdmin. Replaces any active assignment (doubles as Reassign). 409 if driver busy.
Caller assigns own driver profile. 400 if no active driver profile; 409 if busy.
Order: confirmed -> crew_en_route -> picked_up -> dropped_at_shop -> in_progress -> wash_done -> picked_up_from_shop -> returning -> completed. Superadmin / shop admin / assigned driver.
Returns all per-stage damage reports.
Upsert one stage (pickup|dropoff). issues_found = clear|issues. Use multipart variant to attach voice_note.

item.name: Damage check — record (multipart w/ voice note)

request.description: Voice note (max 60s) uploaded to BunnyCDN -> voice_note_url.
IsSuperAdmin. amount_paid / total_refunded / remaining (cap) / prior refunds[].

Provide exactly one of percent | amount. reason: cancellation_by_customer|founder_cancellation|service_quality_issue|damage_during_wash|duplicate_charge|other. mode=manual skips gateway. Cap <= amount_paid (400 over-cap). 502 on gateway failure.
Parallel to carwash. payment_kind = advance | balance picks which payment.
Admin/superadmin: cancels outright -> status=cancelled (no refund issued). Only pending/confirmed cancellable (else 400). Admin scoped to own shop.
Policy-based refund quote (customer-facing). Admin dialog doesn't need it.

IsAdmin (own shop). Single service_id only (multi-service is a known gap). Amount server-computed. Created confirmed, payment_mode=offline. pickup_address_text (free text) or address id; drop via same_as_pickup / drop_address.
Create a saved car for the customer, then pass its id as `car` in the manual booking.
IsAdmin (own shop). Worker cards. on_job decoupled from driver_status.

List fields + detail-only blocks (active_job, this_week, jobs_done, joined). NOTE: this is the Drivers tab only — inspectors have no detail screen in the app (the inspector detail endpoint still works).

Creates User(role=driver) + Drivers record. Created driver_status=active, no SMS. 409 if phone exists. vehicle_classes canonical only. sub_role: wash|wash_hire|hire. license_expiry accepts MM-YYYY on create.

Edit-profile form: patches BOTH the Drivers row AND linked User in one call. All fields optional. full_name/email are WRITE-ONLY (User; never echoed — read response returns nested `user` + computed `name`). Duplicate email -> 400. Suspend via {"driver_status":"suspended"}. license_expiry on PATCH expects ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Other fields: vehicle_classes, license_number, phone, title, masked_phone.
Uploads one side to BunnyCDN. Uploading the missing side of an existing same-kind doc fills it in-place.

IsAdmin. Backs the FRONT ✓ / BACK ✓ verification toggles + rename. Send any of front_verified / back_verified / verified (string bools accepted) / name. Empty body / no editable fields -> 400. doc_id not on this worker -> 404. -> 200 with updated WorkerDocument.
IsAdmin. Removes the WorkerDocument row -> 204 No Content.
Same as drivers; no sub_role, role_label always 'Inspector'. Inspectors are list-only in the app (no detail screen).
Endpoint exists and returns the same rich blocks as driver detail, but the app does not render an inspector detail page.
Identical to hire driver minus sub_role. Created inspector_status=active.
Same field set as the driver edit-profile MINUS sub_role; status field is inspector_status. full_name/email write-only (User). Patches Inspectors row + linked User in one call.
Inspector equivalent of the driver document verify/rename. -> 200 with updated WorkerDocument.
Inspector equivalent -> 204 No Content.
IsAdmin sees all user/driver accounts; user/driver sees only self. Cards with bookings_count, total_spent, last_booking_date.
IsOwnerOrAdmin. Header, stats strip, saved addresses, vehicles, block fields. founder_notes is the only writable field.
IsOwnerOrAdmin. founder_notes is the ONLY writable field; addresses/vehicles are read-only (customer app owns them).
IsAdmin. Merged carwash + DI bookings, newest first, each tagged kind. Custom envelope with extra page/page_size keys.
IsAdmin. is_active=false. reason optional (frequent_no_shows|abusive_behavior|payment_issues|fake_bookings|other); invalid -> 400. Records audit row.
IsAdmin. is_active=true. Clears block_reason/notes/blocked_at/blocked_by; logs unblock audit row.
IsAdmin. Creates a role=user account by phone+name. Include otp_code to verify, omit for override. 409 (with customer_id) if phone exists.
IsSuperAdmin. Unified carwash + DI refund feed. Custom envelope with page/page_size. kind=refund (real row) or request (synthesized awaiting decision).
IsSuperAdmin. {id_or_reference} = numeric id OR RF-... reference. Returns stepper (steps) + next_action (approve|mark_paid|null).
IsSuperAdmin. Approves a customer refund request -> BookingRefund at pending (badge Approved). NO money moves. Provide percent OR amount. Amount cap-checked.
IsSuperAdmin. WHERE MONEY MOVES. Refund must be Approved (pending). Fires Razorpay unless mode=manual. JSON or multipart (screenshot upload). Also: POST .../refunds/{id_or_reference}/mark-paid/.
IsSuperAdmin. URL-form of Mark Paid — refund id/reference in the path; omit `refund` from body.
IsSuperAdmin. Resolves carwash DT-... or DI SR-... booking. Admin-initiated: issues DIRECTLY to Paid (bypasses Approve). Provide percent OR amount. DI: payment_kind=advance|balance.
IsSuperAdmin. Terminal off-ramp from Requested/Approved. No money moves; records audit row. carwash -> confirmed, DI -> cancelled.
IsAdmin. Read-only carwash ShopReview feed. Custom envelope (page/page_size). NOTE: date defaults to last 7 days — pass date=all for full history.
IsAdmin. Read-only. Adds tags, customer_phone, booking link, handled_by (derived), is_flagged (informational; no moderation in v0.1). 404 if missing.
IsAuthenticated. Standard DRF envelope. lifecycle (active|scheduled|paused|expired) is DERIVED. is_active/lifecycle_status are computed read-only.
IsAuthenticated. Same CouponSerializer shape as a list card. 404 if missing.

request.description: IsAdmin. name unique. discount_percentage required>0 for percentage; flat_amount required>0 for flat. shop_ids required (non-empty) when applies_to_all_shops=false. end_date must be after start_date.
IsAdmin. Partial update; cross-field validation merges with stored instance. status=false -> lifecycle_status becomes paused (unless expired).
IsAdmin. 204 No Content.
IsAuthenticated. Customer-surface preview of the rupee discount for a code + order amount (Coupons.validate_redemption). Does NOT create/modify coupons.
